items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Well, Gassum was the banjo. I was playing with his band at one time, and I think I was about 12 or 13 years old.

ctx.x: You know? Yeah. As a matter of fact, I don't know if you all know, Gassum played banjo? I've heard the name. Well, Gassum was the banjo. I was playing with his band at one time, and I think I was about 12 or 13 years old.
